plain.li: I've asked. I've waited. I've asked again. I'm done asking.
There's a whole planet out there. Some of it must have people who listen.
Three days. Then I'm taking my things and my boots and walking until this place is a smudge behind me.
[winter] I'd rather freeze out there than keep being ignored in here. Think about what that means.
[small] You can't afford to lose me. You know that. Act like it.

warm.li: I don't want to go. I really don't. But I can't keep being invisible here.

blunt.li: I'm leaving. Don't bother packing me a lunch.
You've got three days to start treating me like I exist. Then I stop existing here.

cheerful.li: Good news, everyone! I've found a way to stop being disappointed by this colony! It's called leaving!

gloomy.li: I'll probably die out there alone. At least it'll be my choice for once.
Nobody will notice I'm gone. That's sort of the problem.

cold.li: My skills are worth more somewhere they're valued. I'm reallocating them.

plain.li: Somebody listened. Took long enough, but somebody listened.

warm.li: I'm glad I don't have to go. I'd have missed all of you. Even the loud ones.

blunt.li: I'm staying. Don't make me regret it.

cheerful.li: Never mind! I'm staying! Forget everything I said! Especially the shouting!

gloomy.li: Where would I even have gone. Fine. Here's as good a place to suffer as any.

cold.li: The situation has improved enough. I'll stay while that remains true.

plain.li: Don't follow me. Don't write. Not that you could.
Good luck with the next raid. You'll be one gun short.

warm.li: Take care of each other. Better than you took care of me.

blunt.li: Bye. Keep the bed. It was a bad bed.

cheerful.li: So long! It was mostly terrible! Some of you were nice!

gloomy.li: I won't look back. There's nothing back there that looked at me.

cold.li: Consider this my resignation. Effective immediately.
